Q5731.reason: The brother’s interest would divest the uncle upon relocation and is measured by the uncle’s life, making it a shifting executory interest pur autre vie.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove a case, so the plaintiff’s improper removal requires remand of the entire case.

Q5738.reason: Article 2 governs this mixed goods-and-services transaction only if its predominant purpose was the sale of the laptop.
